entries.title: Ephesians 6:1
segments: Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:2
segments: Honor thy father and mother (which is the first commandment with promise),

entries.title: Ephesians 6:3
segments: that it may be well with thee, and thou mayest live long on the earth.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:4
segments: And, ye fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but nurture them in the chastening and admonition of the Lord.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:5
segments: Servants, be obedient unto them that according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ;

entries.title: Ephesians 6:6
segments: not in the way of eyeservice, as men-pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

entries.title: Ephesians 6:7
segments: with good will doing service, as unto the Lord, and not unto men:

entries.title: Ephesians 6:8
segments: knowing that whatsoever good thing each one doeth, the same shall he receive again from the Lord, whether [he be] bond or free.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:9
segments: And, ye masters, do the same things unto them, and forbear threatening: knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no respect of persons with him.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:10
segments: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:11
segments: Put on the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:12
segments: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world-rulers of this darkness, against the spiritual [hosts] of wickedness in the heavenly [places].

entries.title: Ephesians 6:13
segments: Wherefore take up the whole armor of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:14
segments: Stand therefore, having girded your loins with truth, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:15
segments: and having shod your feet with the preparation of the gospel of peace;

entries.title: Ephesians 6:16
segments: withal taking up the shield of faith, wherewith ye shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil [one].

entries.title: Ephesians 6:17
segments: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:

entries.title: Ephesians 6:18
segments: with all prayer and supplication praying at all seasons in the Spirit, and watching thereunto in all perseverance and supplication for all the saints,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:19
segments: And on my behalf, that utterance may be given unto me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the gospel,

entries.title: Ephesians 6:20
segments: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:21
segments: But that ye also may know my affairs, how I do, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things:

entries.title: Ephesians 6:22
segments: whom I have sent unto you for this very purpose, that ye may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:23
segments: Peace be to the brethren, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Ephesians 6:24
segments: Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ with [a love] incorruptible.
